build_user_agent: build a descriptive User-Agent string for QQBot API requests with Python version, OS, and Hermes version
get_api_headers: get standard HTTP headers including Content-Type, Accept, and dynamic User-Agent for QQBot API requests
coerce_list: coerce config values into a trimmed string list from comma-separated strings, lists, tuples, or single values
test_build_user_agent: test the build_user_agent function returns a properly formatted User-Agent string with version info
test_coerce_list: test the coerce_list function handles comma-separated strings, lists, tuples, sets, and None values
